acceptance_summary: Added expand-only idempotent migration DDL for controller, event receipts, identity links, journeys, journey stages, loop runs, and quarantine with all plan-required keys and indexes.
Provided a least-privilege typed ProjectionStore Python API that never copies raw telemetry payloads into projection tables.
Provided execute_batch_transaction API that atomically updates receipts, identity links, journeys, stages, loop runs, quarantine, revision, and checkpoint with PostgreSQL advisory locking.
Proven schema creation idempotency, atomic batch transaction, duplicate event handling, conflicting duplicate detection, identity conflict handling, and quarantine recording against real PostgreSQL.
Captured query EXPLAIN plans verifying index scans for key query paths.
